| **task** | Building a large time-aligned dataset combining financial news (with sentiment) and stock prices to support stock price prediction and sentiment analysis research. | “To address this challenge, we introduce a large-scale financial dataset, namely, Financial News and Stock Price Integration Dataset (FNSPID).” |
| **architecture** | News scraped and merged, summarized with Sumy (LSA, LexRank, Luhn, TextRank), sentiment scored 1-5 by ChatGPT, then sentiment plus open/close/volume fed to DL models to predict close price. | “The news text is processed through the Lsa-summarizer, followed by ChatGPT sentiment quantification. The obtained sentiment score, stock close price, open price, and volume are input into CNN, RNN, LSTM, GRUs, Transformer, and TimesNet.” |
| **data** | 29.7 million stock prices (Yahoo Finance) and 15.7 million news records for 4,775 S&P500 companies, 1999-2023, from NASDAQ plus Bloomberg, Reuters, Benzinga, Lenta; daily prices. Experiments use 50 top S&P 500 stocks. | “It comprises 29.7 million stock prices and 15.7 million time-aligned financial news records for 4,775 S&P500 companies, covering the period from 1999 to 2023, sourced from 4 stock market news websites.” |
| **window** | *not found in the text provided* | |
| **models** | ChatGPT (temperature 0) for sentiment labeling; TextBlob alternative; prediction models LSTM, RNN, CNN, GRU, 4-layer Vanilla Transformer, 4-layer TimesNet. | “Beyond that, we also experimented with more novel methods in financial predictions: 4-layers Vanilla Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) and 4-layers TimesNet (Wu et al., 2023) (Shen et al., 2018) which are both proficient in time series prediction.” |
| **baselines** | Reference group using only open price, close price and volume (no sentiment); TextBlob-labeled sentiment compared with ChatGPT sentiment; models compared to each other. | “Concurrently, a reference group is established, incorporating only stock open price, close price and volume as input variables.” |
| **headline_result** | Transformer best with R^2=0.988 (50-stock training, ChatGPT sentiment); average 6.29% R^2 improvement from 5 to 25 training stocks; ChatGPT sentiment gave 0.2% improvement for Transformer vs -1.16% for TextBlob. | “The Transformer based model has the highest accuracy R^{2}=0.988 ,the LSTM in second place achieved an accuracy of R^{2}=0.856 , and GRU model in third place got R^{2}=0.827 .” |
